# BRC-Shor: fixed-measurement wave sketches and exact four-path purity

Event-ID: brc-shor-fixed-measurement-sketch-20260920-6EF011
Research-Activity-ID: RA-6EF011C2E75C4A799606AFEA
Researcher-ID: EM-DIRECT-6EF011
Status: RESEARCH_CANDIDATE; same-author derivations and finite checks, no independent review, Lean, Working Truth or Foundation admission.
Read source: enterprise-math@3ae6979a97b13062da2c0636362f4ae1a4d94f24. Inherited standalone head18cd2a608dec1e8b5d1be9b5c8cc1fdf3001a510.

## Main result: approximate the output law, not the entire state

For the standard uniform-exponent modular-power state, unit a modulo N and Q=2^m, retain only one predetermined first-register measurement (QFT in the executable), with the second register unconditioned. Construct independent unit-modulus label phases xi(y) which are four-wise independent across distinct labels, with E xi=E xi^2=0. The normalized wave phi(x)=xi(a^x mod N)/sqrt(Q) is order-blind and its ensemble mean density is exactly the true reduced rho.

For each output k, put b_y(k)=Q^(-1)sum_(x:f(x)=y)exp(2 pi i kx/Q). Four-wise phase independence yields E Z(k)=P(k) and Var Z(k)=P(k)^2-sum_y|b_y(k)|^4<=P(k)^2, where Z(k)=|sum_y xi(y)b_y(k)|^2. If P_hat is the average of S independently drawn wave output laws, then

    E TV(P_hat,P)<=1/(2sqrt(S)),
    TV(P_hat,P)<=1/(2sqrt(S))+sqrt(ln(1/delta)/(2S))

with probability at least1-delta. The second statement is McDiarmid applied to replacement of one normalized component law, which changes TV by at most1/S. The number S is independent of Q and r at fixed error/confidence. This is a compact implicit ensemble for ONE measurement, NOT cheap evaluation of its distribution, not uniform over all measurements, and not trace-norm approximation of rho.

## Explicit short seed, no period or field oracle

In a verified GF(2^n), n=ceil(log2N), the binary feature L(y)=(1,y,y^3) has every set of at most4 distinct rows independent. Odd subsets cannot cancel the first coordinate; a four-label cancellation in y has cubic sum (y1+y2)(y1+y3)(y2+y3), nonzero for distinct labels. A uniform(2n+1)-bit mask gives four-wise independent signs sigma(y). Two independent masks give xi(y)=(sigma(y)+i*tau(y))/sqrt(2). One wave uses4n+2 seed bits and needs one modular power, two exact field products and parity operations for one amplitude query. All field polynomials, including preferred64/128-degree ones, pass an exact irreducibility check; search/degree limits and failures are explicit. No factor or period routine is called.

The original pairwise Walsh ensemble is not automatically sufficient for the fourth-moment bound. A general injective-map example f(x)=x gives relative DC variance Q-1 for Walsh phases. This witness is not asserted for every modular map. The cubic hashing adapter, random-phase quadratic estimation and concentration methods have classical prior art; no global novelty or new accepted BRC family is claimed.

## New exact purity identity and an executed hard-input separation

At exponent cut x=u+L*v,Q=L*H,b=a^L, four-wise complex phases leave exactly the two conjugate label pairings, minus the all-equal overlap. Unit cancellation gives the exact ensemble mean Schmidt purity

    E purity = alpha+beta-alpha*beta,
    alpha=K_L(a)/L^2, beta=K_H(b)/H^2.

Instead of secretly computing the huge K_L,K_H, run the unchanged collision engine at an affordable W. If both K_W(a)=W and K_W(b)=W, then alpha<=ceil(L/W)/L, beta<=ceil(H/W)/H. For W dividing both sides, E purity<=2/W-1/W^2. This is a deterministic uniform-ensemble bound, not a Monte Carlo confidence statement.

Executed N18446743979220271189,a2,m128,cut64,W2^24: both K_W equal W; transformed base9473246677577586164. Each call has4096 keys and8191 modular multiplications, plus64 initial squares and2 inverses across both calls. Three repeats gave median4.590120ms certificate time. No full period or128-bit output law was computed.

For S1024, exact rank considerations certify trace_distance(rho,rho_hat)>=16383/16384 for EVERY sketch. Nevertheless its fixed-QFT output law is within1366689692172395665/18446744073709551616 (<0.0741) with99% confidence under independent exact seeds. These are different observers and compatible conclusions. The1024 seeds contain264192 bits (33024 raw bytes, excluding object/parameter overhead); median descriptor construction including field verification was5.4814ms. This does not include a Fourier readout, which correctly refuses the dense budget.

The same certificate bounds mean single-wave purity by33554431/281474976710656. The fraction of these waves admitting Schmidt-rank32 squared-overlap>=0.99 on this cut is at most20971519375/5388156731916288, about3.892151e-6. This is a deterministic bound on an ensemble fraction, not every specified seed and not a general factoring lower bound. It explains why reducing the number of waves does not make their individual contraction low-rank.

## Executable dense baseline and error accounting

compile_dense evaluates the new sketch honestly: Q modular labels/cubes, two UNCHANGED stage11 IntegerQFT transforms per wave, linear complex combination, then squared integer weights. Each component is normalized separately and quantized at a common integer CDF grid before equal averaging. Adding unnormalized component weights directly would wrongly reweight the seed distribution. All production arithmetic is integer/Fraction; stage6 Dyadic and the collision engine are reused unchanged.

The inherited vector residual gives complex-wave numerical TV<=24m/2^p, and common-grid quantization adds at mostQ/G. These deterministic numerical errors add to the statistical sketch-law bound. The implementation has explicit field, descriptor and dense-work gates, with no rejection of difficult random seeds.

Cost remains O(S*m*2^m) fixed-point work and O(2^m) memory, plus modular/field/phase work; after compiling a full Q-entry CDF, drawing an output is O(log Q). A compact descriptor is not a compact contracted state. No competitive Shor or order-finding speedup is established.

Frozen24-run benchmark (three repeats), each compiling then drawing10000 samples from its own fixed approximate law. N23,a2,m10, S16/64/256: median compile120.087908/504.972070/2043.130215ms; median full-law TV against post-run direct modular-fibre reference0.0792107855/0.0629519490/0.0244795897. N71,a2,m14,S64:12085.978103ms, TV0.0459427652. N509,a16,m12,S256:10425.565463ms, TV0.0238341873; this is a small-register diagnostic, not Q>=N^2. Compilation did not get faster as S increased.10000 post-compile draws took median3.37-4.52ms in these cases, NOT including compilation. No CPU pinning. All24 law comparisons fell within the reported conservative bounds, not an independent proof of coverage. Two timeouts preserved complete raw rows; only unrecorded unfinished repetitions resumed.

Reusing a random sketch means outputs are IID conditional on that sketch only. N3,a2,Q2,S1 gives Pr(two zeros)=3/8 versus1/4 for independent true draws. A valid batch bound is delta+batch_size*single_law_error, capped at1; it is not useful for10000 draws at the coarse reported bound. Those draws demonstrate support and amortized cost, not an independent-Shor-batch guarantee.

## Evidence, scope and next

Checks passed:5460 independent field products;44144 exact feature-rank tests;5580 cubic identities;90 independent polynomial irreducibility checks;18 exhaustive complex fourth-moment comparisons;2364 exact modular four-label purity identities;8 full numerical sketch-law comparisons;4000 sample support checks;7 pairwise-family witnesses;integer-only AST;poisoned-order test;7 resource/input tests. Postchecks validated24 raw records,192 hard-case phase queries by separate field arithmetic,3 hard collision replays and4 direct density-matrix versus measurement-distance comparisons. Same author, no independent reviewer, full-project tests or Lean.

BRC reuse: action/label provenance retained; positive four-path counts used only as an observer around signed waves; P023 exact observer discipline extended with an explicit probabilistic TV defect for one final measurement. No physical identification of orthogonal labels, no replacement of phase cancellation by positive masses, no P000 change.

Primary background: Iitaka-Ebisuzaki, Random phase vector for calculating the trace of a large matrix, PRE69,057701(2004), arXiv cond-mat/0401202; Avron-Toledo,JACM58(2011), DOI10.1145/1944345.1944349; McDiarmid, On the method of bounded differences, Surveys in Combinatorics(1989). Detailed adapter proofs and constants are in stage12/PROOF.md. A bounded repository search does not prove novelty.

Next unresolved unit: an affordable contraction or sampler for a single order-blind component, or a different final-measurement representation with charged readout. The number of ensemble components is now controlled independently of register dimension; dense single-wave contraction remains the major cost. Preserve earlier successful spectral samplers and the representation-specific negative results.

The cumulative standalone bundle preserves the main18cd2a6 history and the separate cloud-wavepacket branch. It is not the whole Enterprise Math repository. Previously blocked GitHub executable payloads are not retried; proof/evidence are text checkpoints, with the complete executable bundle on the user-requested Drive surface. Actual upload/hash/readback appear in the later publication receipt; this note does not fabricate them.
